name: Item scaling: a level-scaled creature drops its green items lifted to the level it is shown at
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3 and CoA.ItemScaling=1. The Rake 5807 is a level 10 creature that drops Lionfur Armor 17922 (green, item level 10, required level 5, 108 armor) at 100%. A level 30 character with open-world scaling on fights it at level 27, 17 levels above its own, and item lifts round down to five-level steps, so the armor it drops must be a copy lifted by 15 levels: item level 25, required level 20 and more armor than the authored 108. With scaling off the same creature is fought at 10 and drops the authored item. Client rendering of the copy is not tested.

steps.label: Scaling on shows The Rake at 27
The scaled corpse holds a copy of Lionfur Armor
The copy is lifted to item level 25
The copy carries more armor than the authored 108
The looted copy keeps item level 25
Scaling off shows The Rake at 10
The unscaled corpse holds the authored Lionfur Armor
The authored item keeps item level 10
